title: Ungliyan Kishmish Ban Gayin… Par Kyun? 🤯 #shorts
title_en: Why Do Your Fingers Wrinkle in Water? It's On Purpose 🤯 #shorts
description:
Nahane ke baad ungliyan kishmish jaisi kyun ho jati hain? Sab kehte hain paani andar chala gaya… lekin asal raaz aap ki nasein hain!
Jism jaan boojh kar ye jhurriyan banata hai — aur shayad ye ungliyon ke "tyre" hain.

Your fingers don't wrinkle because they soak up water: your nerves make the blood vessels under the skin shrink, so the skin folds. Scientists think the wrinkles may work like tyre treads for gripping wet things.

description_en:
Why do your fingers wrinkle in water? Not because water soaks in: your nerves tell the blood vessels under the skin to shrink, and the skin folds. Fingers with a cut nerve don't wrinkle at all. Scientists think the wrinkles may work like tyre treads, for a better grip on wet things.
